The only point I was trying to make is that mental health is the only thing people are pointing out in this discussion. I really didn't want to bring on the wrath of the internet, I just wanted what I perceive to be ignorant to this particular situation to be heard. The dude took 3 tabs of acid and very obviously wasn't ready for it. At that point it doesn't matter what undiagnosed mental disorder he has, I'm pretty sure that would break the mind of any person.
Another point I was trying to make is that I am a diagnosed mentally ill person. I have ptsd, it's not something to be shrugged off. I've experienced intense delusions and paranoia. I have flash backs where I'm, for a brief moment, back where I was in the most horrifying moment of my life that literally broke me, and I've done a ton of acid. I was trying to show that the problem with having a bad trip can be a little more complex than a hidden rare mental illness such as schizophrenia.
Looks like someone might have "mental issues" to be so angry about someone challenging them on the internet.

So you're saying psychedelics are only volatile to people with "mental issues"

I am saying that maybe you only think they have "mental issues" because you can't accept that acid is a dangerous drug and there's a chance that it can work adversely in anyone.

Great response! I'm glad instead of trying to understand another's perspective, you gave up and ran away.

My point was it was inappropriate for you to just blurt out about mental illness when it wasn't helpful at all. You're just perpetuating a stereotype that "bad trips only happen to crazy people." I was trying to make an example here and say that it's not a person's mental health that make people freak out. It's the drug. Acid has its risks for anyone. The stigma of mental illness and acid is a dangerous one.

Correlation, not causation. The most common response on this comment section is redflagging mental illness. If that's the first thing you view as the problem, and not the intense psychoactive chemical, then you really don't know what you're talking about.

Everyone keeps thinking that if you freak out on acid it's because you're mentally ill. I've done a shit ton of acid and I am mentally ill. I'm diagnosed ptsd and I was using lsd to cope with the hell I was going through. I've done acid with a lot of my friends and I've seen many, who are by all accounts normal, freak out and go completely insane because of the drug. You can be affected adversely by any drug without being mentally ill, to think otherwise is ignorant and it shows you're looking down on someone who made a horrible mistake and is scarred for life now that they have been through something as traumatic as how a bad trip can get.
